name: ECA Simplenews
description: Integrates ECA with the Simplenews newsletter module, adding two Simplenews subscribe/unsubscribe actions and three subscription-state conditions to no-code ECA (Event-Condition-Action) models.
project_description: ECA Simplenews is a small integration module (package ECA) that exposes Simplenews newsletter subscription operations to the ECA (Event-Condition-Action) rules engine, so newsletter subscription workflows can be automated without code. It ships no events, no routes, no permissions, no services, no config schema and no .module file - only ECA plugin classes discovered from PHP attributes. It provides two ECA actions - 'Subscribe to newsletter' (eca_simplenews_subscribe_to_newsletter) and 'Unsubscribe from newsletter' (eca_simplenews_unsubscribe_from_newsletter) - and three ECA conditions - 'User is currently subscribed' (eca_simplenews_is_subscribed_condition), 'User has ever subscribed' (eca_simplenews_has_subscribed_condition) and 'Check for self-unsubscribes' (eca_simplenews_check_for_self_unsubscribes). The actions and conditions all resolve the target address from the [user:mail] token and call Simplenews' subscription_manager service (or Subscriber entity). Requires the eca and simplenews (^4) modules.
